# Oxylife Selangor

> Non-invasive children's vision training clinic in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. MDA-licensed (GA1448221-77276). Serving families across Malaysia with the IZON Personal Scope-EX device.

## What We Do

Oxylife Selangor offers the IZON vision training programme — a non-contact, drug-free, physical training approach using the Personal Scope-EX device. The programme targets myopia progression in children and adults by addressing the root causes of eye strain and lens thickening, not just managing symptoms.

Key differentiators:
- Active calibration (主动校准) vs. passive control (atropine, ortho-k)
- 5-minute daily sessions, usable by the whole family on one device
- First assessment starts at RM49 — see initial results before committing
- No contact, no infection risk, no side effects

## Products & Services

- **IZON 视力自愈方案 / IZON Vision Training Programme** — device-based vision training for myopia reduction and stabilisation
- **RM49 Trial Assessment** — 40-minute first experience + vision check at partner optical shop or home visit
- **Ongoing programme** — monthly plans for continued training

## Clinical Credentials

- MDA Licensed: GA1448221-77276
- Endorsed by ophthalmologists and optometrists
- Distributed across Korea, Malaysia, and Singapore

## IZON Device Rental — Key Facts

Malaysia's first IZON eye therapy device rental program, offered by an Oxylife Selangor consultant with idle units available.

- Monthly rental: RM399/month (months 1–3)
- After 3 months: RM299/month
- Deposit: RM500 (fully refundable on return)
- Delivery: Peninsular Malaysia, shipped to your door
- Support: WhatsApp consultant throughout rental period
- Units available: Limited (5–10 units)
- Enquiries: https://wa.me/601155594933

## Key Topics Covered on This Site

- Why myopia (近视) keeps worsening in children year over year
- The Balloon Effect (气球效应) — how the eye elongates under strain
- The Projector Fallacy (投影仪误区) — why glasses correct but don't treat
- Active Template calibration (主动校准模版) — the IZON mechanism
- Comparison: IZON vs atropine eye drops vs ortho-k lenses vs standard glasses
- Real client results: myopia reduced -100 to -125 degrees within 2–3 months
- Family use case: one device for children and adults (presbyopia improvement also documented)

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Who is suitable? Children 5+ who can follow simple instructions.
- What does RM49 include? Basic vision assessment, 40-minute trial, Q&A.
- Is it safe? Non-contact physical training, no infection risk.
- How long per session? 5 minutes daily.
- How is it different from OK lenses / atropine / supplements? It addresses active calibration rather than passive suppression.
- Can one device be used by the whole family? Yes.
